description: A per-request override replaces the configured limit while the accounting key follows the descriptor path, exercised with a zero allowance, the maximum unsigned 32-bit allowance, an override applied to a path not present in the configuration under a known domain, and an override carrying an unrecognized unit name.

configs.name: config.yaml
configs.content:
domain: d
descriptors:
  - key: k
    value: kv
    rate_limit:
      unit: second
      requests_per_unit: 9

cases.expected_output:
matched=true
full_key=d.k_kv
requests_per_unit=0
unit=SECOND
unlimited=false
shadow_mode=false
